funding.value: Funding is provided for the first four years of the PhD (five if it is a first graduate degree) for eligible students, with a minimum of CAD 17,000 plus tuition fees per year.
funding.quote: Funding is provided for full-time students for the first two years of the MESc program and for the first four years of the PhD program.

entry_route.value: The PhD requirement listed is a four-year honours degree with at least 78% (last two years); the department funds five years for a PhD as a first graduate degree.
entry_route.quote: Minimum 78% average in a four-year honours degree or equivalent from a recognized university or college
